description: This file defines the 'Extension' model class within the OpenCart admin setting namespace. It manages extension records in the database, including retrieval, installation, uninstallation, and associated paths and install records.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Model class for managing extension records and related data in the OpenCart admin setting namespace.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves all extension records from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Retrieves extension records filtered by a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extension record based on type and code.

methods.name: getTotalExtensionsByExtension
methods.description: Counts total extension records of a given extension type.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates a new extension record in the database.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Deletes an extension record and associated settings from the database.

methods.name: addInstall
methods.description: Adds a new extension installation record to the database.

methods.name: deleteInstall
methods.description: Removes an extension installation record by ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an extension install record.

methods.name: getInstall
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extension install record by ID.

methods.name: getInstallByExtensionDownloadId
methods.description: Retrieves an extension install record by download ID.

methods.name: getInstallByCode
methods.description: Retrieves an extension install record by its code.

methods.name: getInstalls
methods.description: Retrieves multiple extension install records with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalInstalls
methods.description: Counts total extension install records matching filters.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Inserts a path record for an extension install.

methods.name: deletePath
methods.description: Deletes a path record by ID.

methods.name: getPathsByExtensionInstallId
methods.description: Fetches pathway records associated with an extension installation.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves extension path records matching a pattern.

methods.name: getTotalPaths
methods.description: Counts total number of extension path records matching a pattern.
